title: Firefox cookies and site sessions
whyItMatters: Cookie values can still open sites the person stayed signed into. On Windows they are protected with the account, but anything running as that user can read them.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data (cookies.sqlite): https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: One cookies.sqlite per profile; -wal and -shm files appear while Firefox is open.
